---
title: Installing `aat`
---




## Package design

The `aat` package is deliberately split into two independent modules:

- **`aat.core`** implements [the AAT model](./about.qmd) with classes for input of citable text (`CitableToken`/`CitedPassage`), and output of a syntax graph (`AATNode`/`AATGraph`). It includes functions to validate and serialize analyses to a plain-text format.
- **`aat.english`** uses a language model configured with `dspy` to tokenize English text and compose an `AATGraph`.


## Installing

Install the core module directly from this repository:

```sh
pip install git+https://github.com/neelsmith/aat.git
```

To include `aat.english` (the dspy-based English pipeline):

```sh
pip install "aat[english] @ git+https://github.com/neelsmith/aat.git"
```

To pin to a specific branch, tag, or commit  appending `@<ref>` to the URL, e.g.

```sh
pip install "aat[english] @ git+https://github.com/neelsmith/aat.git@v0.1.0`
```
